claims: Monitor respiratory status and oxygen saturation closely given tachypnea (RR up to 27) and SpO2 92-97% on 2-3 L/min nasal cannula.
Monitor heart rate and blood pressure, as tachycardia (HR 104-105) and blood pressure within alarm parameters (SBP 132-134) persist.
Assess and manage pain, with current pain level mild to moderate (3-5), using available analgesics as needed.
Monitor temperature given low-grade fever (99.7°F) and leukocytosis (WBC 19 K/uL), and evaluate for infection.
Continue venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin 5000 units as ordered.
Maintain fall precautions and assist with mobility given weak gait/transferring and bed rest with IV/saline lock.
Monitor electrolytes and renal function (sodium 138, potassium 3.6, creatinine 0.4, BUN 9) and recheck as clinically indicated.
Monitor hemoglobin/hematocrit (11.2 g/dL / 33.6%) for stability, with no evidence of active bleeding.
Continue cardiac monitoring with ST segment monitoring and alarms on.
Perform daily sedation and delirium assessment (Richmond-RAS 0, CAM-ICU negative).
